- <title>ARTIFACT: Museum Night — 18 October 2026, The Old Gallery, Warsaw</title>
- meta description
- Open Graph og:title, og:description, og:image (use https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night), og:type=website

--bg:#070506; --velvet:#1a0710; --burgundy:#3a0f1d; --navy:#07111f; --gold:#d6ad60; --soft-gold:#f3d79b; --ivory:#f8efe2; --muted:#b9a999; --panel:rgba(255,244,220,0.06); --border:rgba(214,173,96,0.28);
Use these throughout. Background: dark velvet/near-black with deep burgundy and midnight navy radial/linear gradients. Add a fixed full-viewport ::before pseudo-element grain/noise overlay built purely with CSS (repeating-conic-gradient or SVG turbulence via CSS filter contrast/opacity trick, or layered repeating-linear-gradient noise) at low opacity, pointer-events:none, mix-blend-mode overlay, z-index high but below interactive content.

=== LAYOUT / SECTIONS (in this order in <body>) ===

1. NAVBAR (sticky, fixed top, glass-like dark panel with backdrop-filter: blur, border-bottom thin gold 1px rgba border):
   - Logo text "ARTIFACT" (serif, gold, letter-spacing)
   - Nav links: Program, Artists, Venue, Tickets, FAQ (anchor links to section ids #program #artists #venue #tickets #faq) with smooth scroll
   - CTA button "Get Tickets" (gold gradient button, scrolls to #tickets)
   - Active nav-link state class "active" toggled via JS IntersectionObserver as user scrolls through sections
   - Mobile hamburger button (three-line icon, pure CSS/SVG) toggling a slide-down mobile menu with same links, aria-expanded managed by JS

2. HERO (id="hero", full viewport height min-height 100vh, cinematic):
   - Background image https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night as CSS background-image on the section with background-size:cover, background-position:center
   - Dark gradient overlay (linear-gradient burgundy/navy/black) + soft radial "spotlight" gradient (gold glow) layered on top via pseudo-element
   - Eyebrow/kicker line "ARTIFACT: Museum Night" (gold, small caps, letter-spacing)
   - Large serif headline "Museum Night, Reimagined" (huge font-size clamp, ivory/soft-gold gradient text)
   - Metadata row with 3 small badge pills (glass panel style): "18 October 2026", "19:00 – 02:00", "The Old Gallery, Warsaw" (use subtle icons via unicode/svg)
   - Two CTA buttons: "Get Tickets" (primary gold filled, links to #tickets) and "Save to Calendar" (secondary outline gold, id="saveCalendarBtn", triggers JS ICS download — no href)
   - subtle scroll-down indicator at bottom

3. CONCEPT / INTRO (id="program" wrapper OR separate id="concept" then id="program" for timeline — use id="concept" for intro, id="program" for timeline section as nav target):
   - Thin gold divider element (hr-like, gradient line) used between major sections throughout the page
   - Short editorial paragraph (2-4 sentences) about the event, elegant serif sub-headline + sans-serif paragraph
   - 3 feature cards in a row (glass dark panel, border gold rgba, hover lift + glow): "After-Hours Exhibitions", "Live Performances", "Guided Hidden-Room Tours" each with short description and a small SVG/unicode icon

4. PROGRAM TIMELINE (id="program", vertical timeline with a gold gradient vertical line and dot markers alternating or left-aligned):
   8 items exactly as given: 19:00 Doors Open; 19:30 Curator Welcome; 20:00 Hidden Collection Tour; 21:00 Live Ambient Performance; 22:00 Sculpture Hall Projection; 23:00 Artist Talk; 00:00 Midnight Gallery Walk; 01:00 Closing Sound Session.
   Each item: time (gold serif), title (ivory), short one-line description (muted), small location tag pill (e.g. "Main Hall", "Atrium", "Sculpture Hall", "Rooftop", "Archive Room", "Theatre", "Grand Staircase", "Sound Chamber" — invent fitting names).
   Add class "reveal" to items for scroll animation.

5. ARTISTS / SPEAKERS (id="artists"):
   Grid of exactly 8 cards, asymmetric sizing allowed (some cards spanning 2 rows via CSS grid for editorial feel). Use these 6 images cycled/reused across 8 cards:
   img1 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?gallery,art
   img2 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?exhibition,lights
   img3 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?sculpture,museum
   img4 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?museum,crowd
   img5 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?art,installation
   img6 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?theater,stage
   Each card: image (object-fit cover), name (invent 8 evocative artist/curator names), role (e.g. "Visual Artist", "Sound Designer", "Chief Curator", "Sculptor", "Performance Artist", "Lighting Designer", "Composer", "Installation Artist"), short teaser sentence, "View details" button with data-artist-id attribute (0-7).
   Store full artist data (name, role, image, long bio 2-3 sentences, session time e.g. "21:00 — Sculpture Hall") in a JS array/object keyed by id, used to populate the modal dynamically.

6. ARTIST MODAL (hidden by default, role="dialog" aria-modal="true", id="artistModal"):
   - backdrop (click closes), panel with image, name, role, long bio paragraph, session time, close button (X, aria-label="Close")
   - Close on ESC key, close on backdrop click, close on close-button click
   - Focus trap not required but move focus to modal on open and restore to trigger button on close (basic accessibility)

7. VENUE (id="venue"):
   - Venue name "The Old Gallery, Warsaw", address (invented realistic Warsaw street address)
   - Travel tips paragraph, accessibility notes paragraph (wheelchair access, accessible restrooms, hearing loop), parking / public transport notes paragraph
   - Inline SVG map mock (hand-built <svg> viewBox, NOT an image): a rectangle/block labeled "Gallery", a few street lines (simple straight/right-angle lines with muted stroke), a metro/bus marker (small circle + icon or letter "M"/"B"), an entrance marker (small pin/dot labeled "Entrance"), and a gold dashed/solid route line (path with stroke var(--gold)) connecting marker to entrance. Keep it schematic/abstract, styled with the palette (dark fills, gold accents, muted grid lines).

8. TICKET TIERS (id="tickets"):
   3 cards: 
   - Night Pass — €29 — bullets: "Entry after 19:00", "Main exhibition access", "Program access"
   - Curator Pass — €59 — "Recommended" badge — bullets: "Everything in Night Pass", "Hidden collection tour", "Reserved artist talk seating"
   - Patron Pass — €129 — bullets: "Everything in Curator Pass", "VIP lounge access", "Signed event print", "Priority entrance"
   Each card has a "Select Tier" button with data-tier, data-price attributes, opens ticket modal pre-filled with that tier. Curator Pass card visually elevated (scale/border glow) with a gold "Recommended" ribbon/badge. Hover highlight lift + glow on all cards.

9. TICKET MODAL / CHECKOUT MOCK (id="ticketModal", role="dialog" aria-modal="true", hidden by default):
   - Shows selected tier name + price
   - Form fields: attendee full name (required), email (required, validated via regex/JS), number of tickets (number input min=1 max=10, default 1)
   - Live-updated total price = tickets * unit price, shown prominently
   - Checkbox "I agree to the terms and conditions" (required)
   - "Confirm Reservation" submit button
   - Client-side validation with inline error messages per field (no alert()); on success hide form / show a success message inside modal AND trigger a toast "Reservation confirmed! Check your email." Explicitly no real payment — add small note "This is a demo — no real payment is processed."
   - Close button, ESC close, backdrop click close

10. FAQ ACCORDION (id="faq"):
    At least 6 Q&A pairs, exactly these questions with sensible short answers (mention no real payment, late arrival allowed until X, photography allowed without flash, venue wheelchair accessible, tier changes via support email, calendar save via button):
    - Is payment processed on this page?
    - Can I arrive late?
    - Are photos allowed?
    - Is the venue accessible?
    - Can I change my ticket tier?
    - How do I save the event to my calendar?
    Implement as accordion: button header (aria-expanded, aria-controls) toggles a panel via JS (max-height/grid-template-rows transition), only inline JS, smooth CSS transition, chevron icon rotates.

11. NEWSLETTER (id="newsletter"):
    Email input + submit button, inline JS validation (basic regex), on invalid show inline error text under input, on valid show a toast "Subscribed! Welcome to ARTIFACT." and clear the input. No backend.

12. FOOTER:
    "ARTIFACT" logo text, short credits line (e.g. "Curated by the ARTIFACT Collective"), row of social-style text links (Instagram, X, Newsletter — href="#", non-functional is fine), copyright line "© 2026 ARTIFACT. All rights reserved.", and a small note "Demo landing page — no real ticket purchase."

=== TOAST NOTIFICATIONS ===
A single reusable toast component (fixed position bottom or top, id="toast") with a JS function showToast(message) that sets text, adds "show" class, auto-hides after ~3.5s via setTimeout, aria-live="polite".

=== SAVE TO CALENDAR (.ics generation) ===
JS function generating an ICS string with exactly:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR / VERSION:2.0 / BEGIN:VEVENT / SUMMARY:ARTIFACT: Museum Night / DTSTART:20261018T190000 / DTEND:20261019T020000 / LOCATION:The Old Gallery, Warsaw / DESCRIPTION:A cinematic after-hours museum event with exhibitions, performances, talks, and guided tours. / END:VEVENT / END:VCALENDAR
(use \r\n line endings). Create a Blob with type "text/calendar", generate an object URL, create a temporary <a> with download="artifact-museum-night.ics", click it programmatically, then revoke the URL. Attach this to both the hero "Save to Calendar" button (id="saveCalendarBtn") — wire it with addEventListener in the script, not inline onclick.

=== SCROLL REVEAL ANIMATIONS ===
Use IntersectionObserver to add a "visible" class to elements with class "reveal" (feature cards, timeline items, artist cards, ticket cards, faq items) when they enter viewport, triggering CSS opacity/translateY transition. Same/related observer (or separate) drives navbar active-link highlighting based on which section id is currently in view.

=== ACCESSIBILITY / POLISH ===
- All interactive elements have visible :focus-visible outline in gold.
- Buttons have hover states (lift/glow/brightness).
- Mobile responsive via media queries (stack columns under ~768px, hamburger nav, adjust hero font clamp, timeline single column, artist/ticket grids collapse to 1 column).
- Ensure valid, well-formed HTML5, no console errors (guard querySelector calls, use optional chaining or existence checks where relevant).
- Use semantic tags: header, nav, main, section, footer, h1-h3 hierarchy.

Write the ENTIRE file from scratch as one cohesive, well-formatted, production-quality HTML document starting with <!DOCTYPE html>. Do not leave any TODO/placeholder comments — all copy must be finished, real-feeling content.
"}
